title: Holy Name Cathedral Site, Brisbane

terrainReference.basis: Original Queensland ground sample on the Ann Street pavement just outside the registered wall.

mapIdentity.provider: Queensland Heritage Register place 600208 and OpenStreetMap street edges
mapIdentity.scope: The standing Holy Name Cathedral sandstone perimeter walls and stone balustrades on Ann Street and the Gotha Street return in Fortitude Valley.

note: The eight-point state heritage perimeter is a narrow L-shaped physical fabric strip, independently aligned with Ann and Gotha Street. Current source ground was frozen before constructing the pale arched wall and balustrade.
